install.WARNING: Prefer aider-install, the official curl / PowerShell installer, or uv. They isolate Aider and provision Python 3.12 when needed. aider-install can bootstrap from Python 3.8–3.13; direct pip / pipx installs support Python 3.9–3.12. Do not reject Python 3.13 when using the bootstrapper or install into an incompatible global Python. System package-manager builds may have incorrect dependencies.
install.note: After install, verify with `aider --version`. The first run will pick up API credentials from environment vars (OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or from ~/.aider.conf.yml — Echobird's 'Update model config' flow writes the YAML for you.
install.pipx (alternative, Python 3.9–3.12): python -m pip install pipx && pipx install aider-chat
install.uv (isolated Python 3.12 — recommended w: uv tool install --python python3.12 --with pip aider-chat@latest

install_flow.summary: Use the official isolated installer → refresh PATH → verify aider.
agent_steps: Detect OS. Prefer the official curl / PowerShell one-liner; it installs Aider with Python 3.12 if needed. If uv is already available, use the uv tool command instead.
If using an existing Python 3.8–3.13, run `python -m pip install aider-install`, then `aider-install` as a separate command. The bootstrapper creates an isolated Python 3.12 environment.
pipx is an alternative only with a supported Python 3.9–3.12 interpreter. Do not use plain global pip as the default.
After install, refresh PATH and run `aider --version`. Preserve ~/.aider.conf.yml and existing model credentials.

identity_guard.description: Aider is an open-source CLI coding agent (paul-gauthier / Aider-AI on GitHub) that supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and many OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It is NOT Aider Pro / aider.app / any commercial fork — install ONLY via the official installers or pip/uv/pipx using the canonical `aider-chat` package.
